## Council preview

- migration-recovery — Question: Can existing sessions recover safely? Evidence: migration and rollback sections. Falsifier: the plan proves sessions can be restored. Boundary: deploy timing.
- launch-observability — Question: Can operators detect and stop a bad rollout? Evidence: health checks and alert gates. Falsifier: the plan has no actionable signal. Boundary: session migration.

Format: Independent panel — the risks use different evidence and can change launch readiness.

Started one real member per persona. Their first views stayed independent. A safe proof read the rollback section and settled the alert-gate conflict. The remaining migration gap stays open.
